extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism ontology from local XML/PDF/figure-caption evidence; computational structure claims are not promoted to direct mechanism.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: viba 11 and vija 10 in the tested bacterial membrane assay context
mechanism_claims.claim_text: Direct membrane-integrity staining supports membrane disruption as an antibacterial mechanism for the assayed cyclotides under the reported conditions.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The local source supports membrane damage qualitatively by fluorescence staining; it does not provide exact percent membrane disruption.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: cycloviolacin O2 against A. baumannii and vija 10 against B. subtilis
mechanism_claims.claim_text: Time-kill kinetics provide direct bactericidal activity evidence at multiples of MIC for the two tested peptide/organism pairs.
mechanism_claims.limitations: This supports bactericidal effect and timing, not a standalone molecular target mechanism.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: viba 11, vija 10, and cycloviolacin O2 structural comparison
mechanism_claims.claim_text: Structure prediction/electrostatic potential analysis is hypothesis-supporting context for relative activity and is not direct mechanism evidence.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Alphafold/electrostatic-potential context is retained as supportive only and not used to overclaim direct mechanism.
